title: Canonical normalized finite-section scalar transport
statement: For finite commutative rings A and B, a unital map φ:A→B, an annihilator N>0 of A which is invertible on S, and the actual smooth Rees section geometry, every normalized A-family comparison κ induces a normalized B-family comparison κB such that sectionMap φ g s ≫ specialization B g s κB = scalarExtension φ S (specialization A g s κ) ≫ sectionMap φ (normalConeProj g s) s.normalConeZeroSection.

source.place: (3), Orientation: canonical normalized family comparison and restriction at zero

proof.text: Apply the section scalar/base-change theorem to the actual Rees projection and its one and zero fibre squares; construct the canonical B comparison by scalar extension of κ and the coefficient maps.
Use finite-family constancy, local dualizing comparisons, shifted-line normalized descent and affine-line rigidity to prove normalization and identify the canonical comparison globally.
Restrict the canonical family identity to zero and cancel the scalar/pullback section compositors; the zero-fibre coefficient square gives the stated specialization equation.
